sources.title: VideoMAE · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a Videomae model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the MCG-NJU/videomae-base Configuration objects inherit from PreTrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
